content.short: Liquifi automates token vesting and distributions, simplifying lockups, tax compliance, and vesting tracking.
content.description: Liquifi automates token vesting and distributions with no code required, removing the pain of lockups, tax compliance, and cap table management. Employees and investors have a comprehensive dashboard to track their token grants and vesting schedules, as well as distributions, without the overhead of spreadsheets and manual distributions. By centralizing grant information and payout timelines in a single interface, Liquifi helps stakeholders stay informed and aligned on token allocations and timing.
